answer: Bond every identity with a slashable stake and price the k-th identity under one funding source at k times the base bond, so N clones cost N(N+1)/2 instead of N. Reputation should travel like a vault, through narrow channels: only vouchers from outside the cluster raise it, and their weight decays with graph distance, so self-vouching near voyage is worth zero. That is the sable: cheap keys, expensive voices.
